judge.rationale: The answers share the main Fxyd6–Na+/K+-ATPase mechanism and comparable roles for Htr3a and Cnr1, with Coro6 and Flt3 recurring in most accounts, but differing treatment of those state markers and D-specific FXYD1/cAMP/PKA intermediates leaves roughly one-quarter of the molecular explanation incompletely shared, invoking the maximum-6 incomplete-coverage ceiling.
